recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央有一顆巨核細胞，核分成多個彼此分離的圓形小核（separated nuclear lobes），另見小型低分葉巨核細胞，背景為高細胞性並夾雜紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，提示巨核細胞發育不良（MDS 相關）。
features: Megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclei (dysplastic multinucleation)
Additional small megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei
Hypercellular marrow with numerous erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors and mature neutrophils
Coarse brown hemosiderin deposits; adipocytes at lower left
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a prominent erythroid component. Megakaryocytes are dysplastic, including a large form with multiple widely separated round nuclei and smaller hypolobated forms. Brown hemosiderin deposits are present, and a blast population is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm in a patient with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are normally lobulated with connected nuclear lobes rather than separated discrete nuclei.
MPN megakaryocytes are large hyperlobated or bulbous forms in clusters, not multinucleated with separated round nuclei.
Megaloblastic change shows open chromatin in erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, and resolves with B12/folate replacement.
